notFound.title: That order is not here any more
notFound.text: You may have cancelled it, or the link is old. Open it again from your orders.

title: Edit order {{code}}

banner.title: After you save, the order goes back to Placed and {{stall}} approves it again.
banner.text: Your stock stays reserved while they review. You get a notification when it is accepted.

help: You can lower quantities or remove items here. To add something else from {{stall}}, place a new order. Quantities are capped at what the stall has left today.
